purpose: Teach: 無くなる/しっくり/どうこう/さび/インチキ/かろうじて/よけい/おわり

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、絵本が無くなるんじゃないかと心配してたわ
lines.en: Sho, I was worried you'd lose your picture books.
lines.style: Soft, concerned. Warm address — using his name to signal care, not sternness. A mother checking in, noticing something small about him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんとの会話がしっくりこないんだ
lines.en: Mom, my conversations with Dad just... don't feel right.
lines.style: Quiet and thoughtful. Not complaining — observing. Slightly hesitant, testing whether he can say this out loud. The perceptiveness of a child noticing what adults miss.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがどうこう言わないでね
lines.en: Sho, please don't blame your father for things.
lines.style: Firm but not sharp. A gentle redirect — protective of both her son and her husband. Practical mother voice, setting a quiet boundary.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんの絵本のさび部分、見たよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw the worn parts in Dad's picture books.
lines.style: Direct observation, no performance. He's noticed something concrete and is reporting it. Matter-of-fact child, connecting dots quietly. A small moment of connection through noticing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、インチキは絶対ダメよ
lines.en: Sho, absolutely no cutting corners or making things up.
lines.style: Clear and steady. Not scolding — laying down a principle. A mother who trusts him to understand the difference between mistakes and dishonesty.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、かろうじて宿題終わったよ
lines.en: Mom, I just barely finished my homework.
lines.style: Small relief in the voice. He did the thing, even if just in time. Not seeking praise — reporting a fact with the quiet satisfaction of having made it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、よけいなことしないでね
lines.en: Sho, don't get sidetracked with other things.
lines.style: Gentle caution. A mother who knows her son's mind can wander. Encouraging focus without criticism — the kind of direction that lets him know she sees him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お話のおわりまで読んで
lines.en: Mom, will you read the rest of the story with me?
lines.style: Hopeful and open. A six-year-old asking for closeness without demanding it. The request carries a quiet want — not just the story, but her presence. Slightly eager, still grounded.
